dct_description_sm:
The ward boundaries, names and numbers will serve as the basis for administering the municipal elections on October 26, 2026. The boundaries amended by By-law No. 2025-5 will take effect on November 15, 2026.

As provided in the Ward Boundaries and Council Composition By-law (By-law No. 2021-3), as amended, the 2026-2030 Term of Council will be composed of the Mayor, elected by general vote, and 24 other members, elected on the basis of one Member for each of the 24 wards. The Councillor information available in the dataset will be updated following the 2026 Municipal Elections to reflect the Council membership for the 2026-2030 Term of Council.

For information on the ward boundaries in effect until November 14, 2026, please refer to the Wards 2022-2026 dataset. 

Accuracy: For information purposes only.

Update Frequency: As required.

Contact: Planning, Infrastructure & Economic Development / Geospatial Analytics, Technology and Solutions
